import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][][][] dp;
    static int capacity, fatCount, slimCount;
    static long[][] ncr;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static long pathfinder(int fatsLeft, int slimsLeft, int ridesLeft, boolean boatPos) {
        if (fatsLeft == 0 && slimsLeft == 0 && ridesLeft == 0)
            return 1;
        if (ridesLeft == 0)
            return 0;
        if (dp[fatsLeft][slimsLeft][ridesLeft][boatPos ? 0 : 1] != -1)
            return dp[fatsLeft][slimsLeft][ridesLeft][boatPos ? 0 : 1];

        long totalWays = 0;
        if (boatPos) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= fatsLeft; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j <= slimsLeft; j++)
                    if (i + j > 0 && i * 2 + j <= capacity)
                        totalWays += (ncr[fatsLeft][i] * ncr[slimsLeft][j] % MOD
                                * pathfinder(fatsLeft - i, slimsLeft - j, ridesLeft - 1, false)) % MOD;
        } else {
            for (int i = 0; i <= fatCount - fatsLeft; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j <= slimCount - slimsLeft; j++)
                    if (i + j > 0 && i * 2 + j <= capacity)
                        totalWays += (ncr[fatCount - fatsLeft][i] * ncr[slimCount - slimsLeft][j] % MOD
                                * pathfinder(fatsLeft + i, slimsLeft + j, ridesLeft - 1, true)) % MOD;
        }
        return dp[fatsLeft][slimsLeft][ridesLeft][boatPos ? 0 : 1] = totalWays % MOD;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        capacity = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine()) / 50;
        int[] arr = Arrays.stream(br.readLine().split(" ")).mapToInt(Integer::parseInt).toArray();

        fatCount = 0;
        slimCount = 0;
        for (int val : arr) {
            if (val == 100)
                fatCount++;
            else
                slimCount++;
        }

        dp = new long[fatCount + 1][slimCount + 1][201][2];
        for (long[][][] layer1 : dp)
            for (long[][] layer2 : layer1)
                for (long[] layer3 : layer2)
                    Arrays.fill(layer3, -1);
        ncr = new long[51][51];
        ncr[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 50; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++)
                ncr[i][j] = (ncr[i - 1][j] + (j > 0 ? ncr[i - 1][j - 1] : 0)) % MOD;

        for (int rides = 1; rides <= 200; rides++) {
            long ways = pathfinder(fatCount, slimCount, rides, true);
            if (ways != 0) {
                System.out.println(rides);
                System.out.println(ways);
                return;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(-1);
        System.out.println(0);
    }
}
